protocol.prompt_assembly: For create-me-a prefix remove the case leading indefinite article; baseline preserves original MakeMe prompt
protocol.acceptance: Unchanged original bounding-box/volume 1%, requested centering 0.001 mm, bore point probes and closed STL
protocol.rules: Preserve all millimeter sizes exactly. Use d for a stated diameter, not r. Use difference to subtract through-holes. Use center=true on all axes when centered at the origin is requested. Return only OpenSCAD code.
limits: Two seeds for sampled setting; no statistical reliability claim
No human changes to generated code
These variants are exploratory and evaluated on the same cases
Loading and file-cache state are not controlled performance variables
